exercises.title: К второй форме добавляется -en, и это язык пассива
exercises.explanation: break — broke — broken, steal — stole — stolen, write — wrote — written, take — took — taken, choose — chose — chosen, speak — spoke — spoken, eat — ate — eaten, see — saw — seen.
